observations: The round's riskiest change is the latched refusal, because a latch that outlives its task stops the registration refresh and brings INFRA-246 back. Three measurements say it does not: the stall arm logged 7 accepted registrations past the wedged third with the stall said exactly once, the recover arm re-registered at 91s, and the role-takeover smoke's A5 row shows a process whose claim was refused taking the role on its next session event.

The second kept-registration reason is reachable on the wire, not only in a unit test: 5 of 25 rounds of a delete racing its own instance's heartbeat answered 'the registration changed while it was being removed', and none answered the other reason. Before this round all five would have told the client its own registration belonged to another instance.

One behaviour this round changed has no real surface I can drive on demand: sessionLeftDuringClaim now tells the Legion bridge and envoy_role_set apart a claim the listener refused from one it granted and claimRole adopted after the session moved. Reaching it needs a session to move inside the window of one claim. It is covered by the module's own tests (registration-state.test.ts:836 'a claim the listener granted after the deadline is recorded, not adopted', :897 and :926 for the adoption and the refusal), which is what A1 asks for, and the claim path around it is driven by every row of the smoke. Recorded so the reviewer knows which part of this round rests on unit tests alone.

The implement handoff's open question about packages/pi-envoy/scripts/smoke-replay.sh is corroborated and narrowed. Its ANTHROPIC_API_KEY prerequisite is main's, unchanged by this pull request (diffed against main@origin: the change to that file is the sourced local-stack.sh, port_range, and wait_until delegating to poll_until). Run as it stands the script refuses at that gate before building anything. Run with SMOKE_REPLAY_PROVIDER_ENV=ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, which this pod does set, it gets past the gate, the extracted bring-up works in that script's own call sites, a real pane starts and runs its first prompt, and it then ends SMOKE REPLAY FAIL (leg-1-reconnect): 'omp finished its first prompt but wrote no session file' — the pod's OMP_SESSION_STORAGE, which is that smoke's premise and nothing this change touches.

The instance id is still exposed by no read route and still carried structurally: sessionInfo (api.go) names no such field, and RegistrationInput remains Omit<SubscribeInput, 'clientInstanceID'>, so no pi-envoy call site can send a registration without it.
